rca of the issue: Pre-fix: PlayerRoster.tsx still rendered the module-level hardcoded LEAGUE_ROSTER_SLOTS (7 slots: C, C, LW, RW, W, D, UTIL) regardless of the active league's position_breakdown.active. Iter180 attempted fix: shadow the module constant with a useMemo'd version derived from useActiveLeague (PlayerRoster.tsx:768-771). The source-code change is in place and the file-content tests in test_iter180_dynamic_roster_slots.py confirm the string presence — but runtime behaviour shows the fallback path is being taken. Likely root cause: the league object returned by useActiveLeague does not include the position_breakdown field, OR the hook returns a stale snapshot taken before the PUT updated the league. Suggested investigation: log `activeLeagueFromHook` and `(activeLeagueFromHook as any)?.position_breakdown?.active` at render time on /team — if `undefined`, the hook is the bug; if present, the buildLeagueRosterSlots helper or its consumers are the bug. Reproduction confirmed via Playwright screenshot at /tmp/team_dynamic_slots.png — STARTING ROSTER reads C, C, LW, RW, W, D, UTIL (7 slots, hardcoded) even though /api/leagues/{id} returns the expected breakdown.
